verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋਈ ਮਿਲੈ ਆਪਾ ਖੋਇ ਸੋਈ ਤਉ ਨਾਯਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਮਾਨ ਕੀਏ ਮਾਨਮਤੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਨ ਮਾਨ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: joiee milai aapaa khoi soiee tau naayakaa hoi maan ke'ee maanamatee paieeaai na maan jee ||

en.bdb: The seeker woman who sheds her ego and meets with dear husband, she alone is the loved wife of the husband. One cannot get honour and respect from the Lord if one feels haughty and egoistic.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਘਨਹਰ ਬਰਸੈ ਸਰਬਤਰ ਸਮ ਉਚੈ ਨ ਚੜਤ ਜਲ ਬਸਤ ਨੀਚਾਨ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise ghanahar barasai sarabatar sam uchai na chaRat jal basat neechaan jee ||

en.bdb: Just as clouds rain equally in all places, its water cannot climb up the mounds. Water always go and settles at lower levels.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਨ ਸਮੀਪ ਜੈਸੇ ਬੂਡਿਓ ਹੈ ਬਢਾਈ ਬਾਂਸ  ਆਸ ਪਾਸ ਬਿਰਖ ਸੁਬਾਸ ਪਰਵਾਨ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: cha(n)dhan sameep jaise booddio hai baddaiee baa(n)s  aas paas birakh subaas paravaan jee ||

en.bdb: Just as a bamboo stays in his pride of being high and lofty and remains bereft of the fragrance of sandalwood, but all big and small trees and plants absorb that sweet smell in themselves.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਸਿੰਧ ਪ੍ਰਿਯ ਤੀਯ ਹੋਇ ਮਰਜੀਵਾ ਗਤਿ  ਪਾਵਤ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਜੀ ॥੬੬੨॥
verses.translit_en: kirapaa si(n)dh piray teey hoi marajeevaa gat  paavat param gat sarab nidhaan jee ||662||

en.bdb: Similarly, to be the wife of the ocean of kindness-dear Lord, one has to sacrifice oneself and become a living dead person. Only then can one acquire the treasure of all treasures (God's name from the True Guru) and reach the supreme divine state.  (662)
